[CHARACTER PROPORTIONS]
A stylized hyperreal fantasy film portrait of a fictional sixteen-year-old European schoolgirl with refined doll-inspired facial proportions and delicately believable skin. Deliberately idealized youthful proportions: large expressive grey-green eyes with bright glossy catchlights, a petite delicate nose, a small softly defined mouth, a slim V-shaped face with a gently tapered chin. [SKIN MATERIAL] Fair ivory skin with subtle natural tonal variation, very fine restrained microtexture, soft matte cheeks and a delicate blush, gentle localized highlights and nuanced cinematic shading.
[HAIR, EXPRESSION, SCENE]
Long pale golden-blonde hair loose over both shoulders with fine wispy face-framing strands. Calm confident slightly aloof gaze, relaxed brows, lips closed. A dark high-neck school robe, silver earrings. Frontal head-and-shoulders composition, complete head visible, softly blurred cool-toned magical school corridor, cinematic soft window light and delicate warm highlights. High-end semi-realistic digital character rendering, expressive stylized facial design, delicate fantasy-film beauty.
